name: bee4stitch-web
description: Bee4Stitch web preview — static site with serverless functions (api/publish-machine.js, api/machines.js, api/logs.js) backed by a Postgres cloud database for the Cutter Performance Browse-and-publish flow. No build step for the site itself; the API functions have one dependency (pg) that Vercel installs automatically.

scripts.test: node tests/cutter-performance-logic.test.js && node tests/next2-browser-reader.test.js && node tests/db.test.js && node tests/publish-machine.test.js && node tests/api-handlers.test.js
